q: What is a load factor incentive on an HT electricity bill and how do I earn it?
title: Load factor incentive on an HT bill
short: Some state tariffs give a rebate when load factor is high: units used divided by maximum demand times hours in the month. Running steadily across shifts, instead of in peaks, raises it. It lowers cost; emissions still follow kWh.
audience: HT consumers in states whose tariff orders offer load factor rebates

ol: Recorded maximum demand in kVA, times power factor for kW.
Load factor = kWh ÷ (kW × hours in the month).

p: Thresholds and rebate rates differ by state and year. Read the current tariff order for your category.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including kVAh, demand and solar export lines, into dated records with the units, factor and year behind every Scope 2 figure.
